method: Pooled LightGBM per horizon (1-6 months after the issue month), isotonic-calibrated on out-of-fold predictions. Inputs available on the issue date: Ember hydro anomaly at t-2, GRACE-FO TWS at t-3, GPCP rain and NASA POWER soil/temperature at t-1, ONI at t-1. Shortfall = hydro capacity factor >= 15% below that calendar month's normal; severe = >= 30% below.
alarm_definition: alarm = P(any shortfall in the next 6 months) >= 0.66 (threshold set for <= 1 false alarm per country per 5 calm years in the backtest)
